stages.seo-autopilot: Crawled 114 sitemap URLs and 122 internal link targets with zero technical findings. Rendered page signatures and control files match the verified November 18 release. Nine mapped live queries have distinct targets. Comparison searches had mixed intent and no new comparison qualified. Direct Google AI Overview observations established a baseline for the five saved buyer prompts.
stages.blog-refresher: Read both blog URLs under the /blog/ filter in the 28-day Search Console Web report. Reported impressions were below the 30-impression per-query threshold. The report warned that filtered results might be partial. No qualifying query-by-page evidence was established, so no refresh was published.
stages.seo-title-optimization: Reviewed rendered metadata, existing product routes and recent editorial holds. The only reported page reaching 100 impressions is a model matchup on hold through December 14. No matched device-and-position CTR experiment or verified editorial correction qualified.

evidence.search_console: The signed-in Chrome session supplied the October 23 through November 19 Web report. Page impressions were sorted for title eligibility. Exact figures were retained locally. API finalization, URL Inspection and matched device comparisons were unchecked.
